name: Agent definition
description: The content-addressed configuration blob an agent-document points at via its agentDefinition metadata field. Unsigned; authority comes from the signed document that references it. Signing identities are referenced by principal, never by server-local key name. Server-private material (API keys, OAuth sessions, raw signing keys) is deliberately absent: it stays on the agent server.

systemPrompt.description: The agent's system prompt: plain text, or a rich Seed block tree.

reasoningLevel.description: Reasoning level for reasoning-capable models; absent means off or the provider default.

enabledModels.description: Quick-switch model choices, possibly spanning providers.

tools.description: Names of enabled tools in the agent's tool space.

mcpServers.description: Names of the account's MCP servers this agent may call.

signingIdentities.description: Principals of the Hypermedia accounts this agent may sign as. The agent signs its own published content (messages, comments, documents) with one of these; the server signs infrastructure records with server identities. Which of the two signs a given record is a deliberate, per-record-type choice.
